---
title: "Fake-data recovery of the space-time model"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
params:
  areas: barcelona
  from: "2020-09-01"
  to: "2020-12-31"
  time_effect: 2      # defaults: the final model, MODEL in helpers.R; the other switches as 5_spacetime.qmd
  negbin: 1
  gamma_prior: 0.2
  lag_dist: 0
  lag_min: 4
  pooled: 1
  phi_area: 1
  holiday: 1
  testing: 0          # 1: whole mean (Slater eq. 5); 2: pi_t on endemic, pi_t / pi_t-s on epidemic
  no_within: 0
  mob_lags: 2
  ne_powerlaw: 0
  day_effect: 0
  placebo: 0
  covariates: 1
  n_sims: 3           # simulated data sets, each refitted (Barcelona: about 15 minutes per fit)
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Can the model recover what it is used for? Counts are simulated from the model at known values, here posterior draws
of the fit to the observed data (`7_checks.qmd`'s fit, with the expected cases of each ABS-day), and the model is
refitted to each simulated data set. A quantity is recovered when its true value lies inside the refit's 95%
interval. The checks that matter here are the mobility share and trips per new infection, given the weekly time effect
and the ABS x week interaction, which can also follow the waves; and the between-ABS sds and covariate effects of the
pooled coefficients.

Two limits. The simulated counts do not feed back into the lagged pressures: those stay the observed ones, so the check
is of the model as fitted, conditional on the observed history. And the true values are posterior draws, not prior
draws, so this is a recovery check, not simulation-based calibration (Modrák et al. 2025): with the wide priors on the
coefficient means (log-normal, sd 3 on the log scale), prior draws give implausible counts. Fits are cached in
`outputs/recovery/`. Render from `end-epi/slater`.

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressMessages({library(rstan); library(ggplot2)})
stopifnot("run from end-epi/slater" = file.exists("helpers.R"))
if (!isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params = rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter("8_recovery.qmd")$params   # running chunks interactively
source("helpers.R")
switches = modifyList(params, list(save_expected = 1))
window_key = paste(params$areas, params$from, params$to, sep = "_")
key = paste(window_key, spacetime_variant(switches), sep = "_")
dir.create(out("recovery"), showWarnings = FALSE)
key
```

## Fit to the observed counts

```{r}
#| label: fit
f_inputs = out(paste0("daily_", window_key, "_inputs.rds"))
d = if (file.exists(f_inputs)) readRDS(f_inputs) else daily_inputs(params$areas, as.Date(params$from), as.Date(params$to))
if (!file.exists(f_inputs)) saveRDS(d, f_inputs)
data_st = spacetime_data(d, switches)
model = rstan::stan_model("stan/spacetime.stan")
f = out(paste0("spacetime_", key, ".rds"))     # the same file as 7_checks.qmd
if (file.exists(f)) fit = readRDS(f) else {
	fit = rstan::sampling(model, data = data_st, iter = 1000, warmup = 500, chains = 4, cores = 4, refresh = 50,
		pars = "log_lik", include = FALSE)
	saveRDS(fit, f)
}
```

## Simulated data and refits

The true values are draws spread evenly over the posterior sample.

```{r}
#| label: refits
quantities = function(x) {     # x = rstan::extract() of a fit
	components = x$endemic_day + x$autoregressive_day + x$neighbour_day + x$mobility_day
	q = cbind(mobility_share = rowSums(x$mobility_day) / rowSums(components), trips_per_infection = 1 / x$infections_per_trip,
		autoregressive_share = rowSums(x$autoregressive_day) / rowSums(components), gamma_sd = x$gamma_sd[, 1],
		delta_sd = if (!is.null(x$delta_sd)) x$delta_sd[, 1], phi_median = apply(x$phi, 1, median))
	if (!is.null(x$lag_mean)) q = cbind(q, lag_mean = x$lag_mean[, 1])
	if (!is.null(x$ne_decay)) q = cbind(q, ne_decay = x$ne_decay[, 1])
	if (!is.null(x$day_sd)) q = cbind(q, day_sd = x$day_sd[, 1])
	if (!is.null(x$coef_sd) && ncol(x$coef_sd)) q = cbind(q, `colnames<-`(x$coef_sd, paste0("sigma_", c("EN", "AR", "NE", "MOB1", "MOB2"))[seq_len(ncol(x$coef_sd))]))
	if (!is.null(x$beta_cov) && ncol(x$beta_cov)) q = cbind(q, `colnames<-`(x$beta_cov, paste0("beta_", names(COVARIATES))))
	q
}
x = rstan::extract(fit)
truth = quantities(x)
draws = round(seq(1, nrow(truth), length.out = params$n_sims + 2))[-c(1, params$n_sims + 2)]
set.seed(1)
results = do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(draws), \(k) {
	g = draws[k]
	f_sim = out(file.path("recovery", sprintf("%s_draw%d.rds", key, g)))
	if (file.exists(f_sim)) refit = readRDS(f_sim) else {
		data_sim = modifyList(data_st, list(save_expected = 0L))
		data_sim$cases = array(as.integer(rnbinom(length(x$expected_cell[g, , ]), size = rep(x$phi[g, ], ncol(d$cases)),
			mu = x$expected_cell[g, , ])), dim(d$cases))
		refit = rstan::sampling(model, data = data_sim, iter = 1000, warmup = 500, chains = 4, cores = 4, refresh = 0,
			pars = "log_lik", include = FALSE)
		saveRDS(refit, f_sim)
	}
	q = quantities(rstan::extract(refit))
	data.frame(sim = k, quantity = colnames(q), truth = truth[g, colnames(q)], median = apply(q, 2, median),
		lo = apply(q, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi = apply(q, 2, quantile, 0.975),
		rank = vapply(colnames(q), \(p) mean(q[, p] < truth[g, p]), 0),      # share of refit draws below the truth
		divergent = rstan::get_num_divergent(refit), max_rhat = max(rstan::summary(refit)$summary[, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE))
}))
results$covered = results$truth >= results$lo & results$truth <= results$hi
```

## Recovery

True value (red) and the refit's median and 95% interval, for each simulated data set. Covered: the share of
simulations whose interval holds the true value.

```{r}
#| label: recovery
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(results, aes(factor(sim), median)) + geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi)) +
	geom_point(aes(y = truth), colour = "red", shape = 4, size = 3) + facet_wrap(~quantity, scales = "free_y") +
	labs(x = "Simulated data set", y = NULL)
aggregate(cbind(covered, rank) ~ quantity, results, mean)
unique(results[c("sim", "divergent", "max_rhat")])
```
